description.describe_ch:
本課程將主要介紹設計導向之幾何運算與參數式關聯建構，將會以圖像式編程軟體Rhino-Grasshopper為主要之操作平台，其中將會介紹相關的延伸功能、介面操作與邏輯建構。

目標是訓練完整之3D建構空間能力，並將圖像編輯之程式語言視為創作工具與媒介，使跨領域背景學生能運用程式進行複雜運幾何運算、參數化、智慧化之工作，進而創造自己的數位創作流程與新工具。
description.describe_eh:
This course mainly based on design-oriented geometric operations and parametric construction. Visual programming software Rhino-Grasshopper will be used as the main design platform, and the related extended functions, operation rules and will also be introduced. 

It will provide participants the training with the basic knowledge of 3D space construction, and using the visual programming as imagination and design tool, so it will encourage cross-domain students can use the tool to solve the complex geometric issue, establish the relationship of parameters, make their work intelligent, and create their own digital creative project.

targets.describe_ch: 學會3D建模，並了解參數式設計概念與實作方法。
targets.describe_en: Learn 3d modeling and understand parametric design concepts and applications.

targets.describe_ch: 嘗試不同的演算方法，實現更多元化的設計方法與型態。
targets.describe_en: Experiment with different algorithm to try diversity design approach and types.

targets.describe_ch: 整合技術與設計邏輯，進而完成一獨特之設計專案
targets.describe_en: Integrate technology and design logic to complete a unique design project

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂規則，習慣班級文化。
一、課堂禮儀
1.	多元化和包容性
課程活動都在同學間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間應尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、種族文化、社經背景、性別等。
2.	課堂行為
(1)	學生應準時出席上課；如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。
(2)	上課時請勿講話、閱讀其他刊物、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除積極參與分組討論外，應減少與旁邊同學對話。
(3)	當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。
二、課程交流及網路禮儀
1.	iLearn仍然是教室，必須遵守適當的課堂行為，尊重同學和老師。
2.	您應留出時間，積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並完成所有交付之學習任務，來完成課程活動。
3.	每次線上討論區，不要強勢主導任何討論，要給其他同學參加討論的機會，以提高每個人的學習體驗。
(1)	每個人均要保持開放的態度，尊重少數意見，甚至您也可以表達不同的意見。
(2)	適當地提出您的想法，並避免使用粗俗或令人反感的語言。
(3)	依主題寫作，重點和簡短表達。
(4)	在發表評論之前先閱讀所有發表文章或評論，再撰寫，以防止重複評論或提出已經回答的問題。
(5)	撰寫評論文字，應審閱、再審閱後發送。
(6)	網路溝通的語言。請避免過度使用表情符號。
(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
三、學生責任
1.	每位學生於每學期開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的個人基本資料，包含手機電話、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
(1)	確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID是開通的，o365作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
(2)	與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
(3)	您的電子郵件要署名，老師不會回覆“匿名”信件。
2.	您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
3.	隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
4.	您應依老師的授課內容與教學方式，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助老師改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及學習活動的安排。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Behavior in the classroom should always be timely, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. To facilitate effective learning, mutual dignity and respect between classmates and teachers are essential. To ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is encouraged to adhere to the following points and comply with classroom rules while embracing class culture.

I. Classroom Etiquette

Diversity and Inclusivity:
Course activities should take place in a friendly atmosphere of student participation and interaction. Mutual respect and appreciation for each classmate's personal experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, including different academic systems, diverse admissions and learning cultures, ethnic cultures, socioeconomic backgrounds, and genders, are crucial.

Classroom Behavior:
(1) Students should attend classes on time. If you cannot attend classes punctually, please do not enroll.
(2) During class, refrain from talking, reading other materials, sleeping, or engaging in unrelated activities. Minimize conversations with neighboring students, except when actively participating in group discussions.
(3) When classmates are presenting or asking questions, focus on listening attentively.

II. Course Communication and Online Etiquette

iLearn remains a classroom, and appropriate classroom behavior must be observed, respecting both classmates and teachers.
Allocate time to actively participate in iLearn online learning activities and complete all assigned learning tasks to fulfill course requirements.
In online discussion forums:
(1) Maintain an open attitude, respect minority opinions, and express different perspectives.
(2) Articulate your thoughts appropriately, avoiding the use of vulgar or offensive language.
(3) Write concisely and focus on the topic.
(4) Read all posts or comments before posting to avoid repeating comments or asking already answered questions.
(5) Review and proofread your comments before posting.
(6) Use appropriate language in online communication. Avoid excessive use of emoticons.
(7) Refrain from using local dialects or slang that may lead to misunderstanding.
(8) Do not mock someone's reading or writing abilities when sharing tips with other students.
(9) Consider others' privacy. Obtain permission before sharing classmates' email addresses or other information.
(10) Do not post inappropriate messages; refrain from forwarding virus warnings, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or teachers.
III. Student Responsibilities

Before the start of each semester, confirm and update personal basic information, including phone numbers and mailing addresses, in the MyFCU personal data form for effective communication with instructors, teaching assistants, or department staff.
(1) Ensure that your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID are active, as o365 serves as a common tool for teaching and learning communication between students and faculty.
(2) Clearly communicate information and maintain politeness when exchanging emails, bulletin board posts, etc.
(3) Sign your emails, as teachers will not reply to "anonymous" messages.
Read and understand the course syllabus requirements, promptly update with the latest information, and manage your study time effectively.
Regularly check your Feng Chia University email and log in to iLearn to stay informed about course announcements.
Provide feedback on the course by completing mid-term and end-of-term teaching evaluations based on the teacher's content and teaching methods. Your participation and feedback will help improve teaching skills, course content, and learning activity arrangements. Complete the formative teaching assessment in weeks 4-8, mid-term student opinion survey, and end-of-term course goal achievement assessment in the last month of the semester.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。
  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。
3.    學生有責任做好自己的學習任務，並避免一切形式的學術不誠實行為。
  • 不作弊：紙筆測驗時，不得交談、窺竊他人試卷或故意便利鄰座竊窺，或有夾帶、抄襲或傳遞資料等情事經發現時，違者該次考試成績以零分計算。並視違者情節，或有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，將依逢甲大學學生考試辦法、學生獎懲辦法之相關規定處理。
  • 不抄襲：提交原創作品，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲。
  • 不偽造：篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
  • 不篡改/不捏造：從實驗中蒐集數據過程，以人為方式創建數據或編造不存在的數據或資料來源，均被視為捏造或篡改
  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。
以上情況視違者情節，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定提送處分。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1.      Integrity is a declaration of fundamental attitudes and professional values, serving as a commitment to transform academic ideals into action and uphold social responsibility.
 
2.      One of the most crucial values of academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and the respect for others' intellectual property rights.
  • Students should prioritize and adhere to intellectual property rights. Unauthorized assistance is prohibited in academic activities, including the use of library collections, copyrighted textbooks, and audio-visual materials.
  • Adherence to integrity involves actively attending and participating in classroom learning commitments.
  • Students should respect each individual in the classroom and conduct themselves responsibly and courteously at all times.
3.      Students have the responsibility to fulfill their learning tasks and avoid all forms of academic dishonesty.
  • No Cheating: During written exams, students are not allowed to talk, peek at others' papers, intentionally facilitate neighboring students' cheating, or engage in activities such as hiding, copying, or passing on information. If violations are discovered, the offender's score for that exam will be counted as zero. Depending on the severity of the violation or involvement in impersonation, both parties involved in cheating will be dealt with according to the relevant regulations in Feng Chia University's Student Examination Measures and Student Rewards and Penalties Measures.
  • No Plagiarism: Submitting original works strictly prohibits any form of plagiarism.
  • No Forgery: Tampering with grades or other official documents, such as medical certificates from clinics.
  • No Tampering/No Fabrication: Manipulating the process of collecting data from experiments, creating data or sources that do not exist in a human-made way, is considered fabrication or tampering.
  • No Destruction: Damaging others' artworks, experiments, or design achievements is considered destructive behavior. Failure to contribute to a team project is also considered academic destruction.
In all the above situations, the severity of the violation will be considered, and the offender will be subject to disciplinary actions according to the relevant regulations in Feng Chia University's Student Rewards and Penalties Measures.

integrity.ais_meno_en:
1.      Integrity is a declaration of fundamental attitudes and professional values, serving as a commitment to transform academic ideals into action and uphold social responsibility.
 
2.      One of the most crucial values of academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and the respect for others' intellectual property rights.
  • Students should prioritize and adhere to intellectual property rights. Unauthorized assistance is prohibited in academic activities, including the use of library collections, copyrighted textbooks, and audio-visual materials.
  • Adherence to integrity involves actively attending and participating in classroom learning commitments.
  • Students should respect each individual in the classroom and conduct themselves responsibly and courteously at all times.
3.      Students have the responsibility to fulfill their learning tasks and avoid all forms of academic dishonesty.
  • No Cheating: During written exams, students are not allowed to talk, peek at others' papers, intentionally facilitate neighboring students' cheating, or engage in activities such as hiding, copying, or passing on information. If violations are discovered, the offender's score for that exam will be counted as zero. Depending on the severity of the violation or involvement in impersonation, both parties involved in cheating will be dealt with according to the relevant regulations in Feng Chia University's Student Examination Measures and Student Rewards and Penalties Measures.
  • No Plagiarism: Submitting original works strictly prohibits any form of plagiarism.
  • No Forgery: Tampering with grades or other official documents, such as medical certificates from clinics.
  • No Tampering/No Fabrication: Manipulating the process of collecting data from experiments, creating data or sources that do not exist in a human-made way, is considered fabrication or tampering.
  • No Destruction: Damaging others' artworks, experiments, or design achievements is considered destructive behavior. Failure to contribute to a team project is also considered academic destruction.
In all the above situations, the severity of the violation will be considered, and the offender will be subject to disciplinary actions according to the relevant regulations in Feng Chia University's Student Rewards and Penalties Measures.

policy.tpa_score_new: 本課程將主要為: 訓練運算設計所需之建模與programming能力，以設計導向之參數式幾何運算為主要之概念，將會以圖像式編程軟體Rhino-Grasshopper & Coding為主要之操作工具，其中將會介紹相關的延伸功能與操作介面等…，內容包括設計者之邏輯運算觀念、關聯式設計方法、樹狀結構之資料處理，並延伸產出2D或3D運算設計作品。 評分重點: 包括課程參與、自主學習、修課前後學習狀況。 課程參與和平時表現50% 、 其中發表或測驗20%、 期末發表30% 包括課程參與、自主學習、團隊合作與修課前後學習狀況。 課程需求: 自備筆記型電腦，需可執行 Windows 作業系統。 若為Mac請確認是否可使用Rhino7 for Windows !
policy.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂規則，習慣班級文化。
一、課堂禮儀
1.	多元化和包容性
課程活動都在同學間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間應尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、種族文化、社經背景、性別等。
2.	課堂行為
(1)	學生應準時出席上課；如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。
(2)	上課時請勿講話、閱讀其他刊物、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除積極參與分組討論外，應減少與旁邊同學對話。
(3)	當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。
二、課程交流及網路禮儀
1.	iLearn仍然是教室，必須遵守適當的課堂行為，尊重同學和老師。
2.	您應留出時間，積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並完成所有交付之學習任務，來完成課程活動。
3.	每次線上討論區，不要強勢主導任何討論，要給其他同學參加討論的機會，以提高每個人的學習體驗。
(1)	每個人均要保持開放的態度，尊重少數意見，甚至您也可以表達不同的意見。
(2)	適當地提出您的想法，並避免使用粗俗或令人反感的語言。
(3)	依主題寫作，重點和簡短表達。
(4)	在發表評論之前先閱讀所有發表文章或評論，再撰寫，以防止重複評論或提出已經回答的問題。
(5)	撰寫評論文字，應審閱、再審閱後發送。
(6)	網路溝通的語言。請避免過度使用表情符號。
(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
三、學生責任
1.	每位學生於每學期開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的個人基本資料，包含手機電話、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
(1)	確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID是開通的，o365作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
(2)	與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
(3)	您的電子郵件要署名，老師不會回覆“匿名”信件。
2.	您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
3.	隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
4.	您應依老師的授課內容與教學方式，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助老師改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及學習活動的安排。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。
policy.course_pol_en:
Behavior in the classroom should always be timely, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. To facilitate effective learning, mutual dignity and respect between classmates and teachers are essential. To ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is encouraged to adhere to the following points and comply with classroom rules while embracing class culture.

I. Classroom Etiquette

Diversity and Inclusivity:
Course activities should take place in a friendly atmosphere of student participation and interaction. Mutual respect and appreciation for each classmate's personal experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, including different academic systems, diverse admissions and learning cultures, ethnic cultures, socioeconomic backgrounds, and genders, are crucial.

Classroom Behavior:
(1) Students should attend classes on time. If you cannot attend classes punctually, please do not enroll.
(2) During class, refrain from talking, reading other materials, sleeping, or engaging in unrelated activities. Minimize conversations with neighboring students, except when actively participating in group discussions.
(3) When classmates are presenting or asking questions, focus on listening attentively.

II. Course Communication and Online Etiquette

iLearn remains a classroom, and appropriate classroom behavior must be observed, respecting both classmates and teachers.
Allocate time to actively participate in iLearn online learning activities and complete all assigned learning tasks to fulfill course requirements.
In online discussion forums:
(1) Maintain an open attitude, respect minority opinions, and express different perspectives.
(2) Articulate your thoughts appropriately, avoiding the use of vulgar or offensive language.
(3) Write concisely and focus on the topic.
(4) Read all posts or comments before posting to avoid repeating comments or asking already answered questions.
(5) Review and proofread your comments before posting.
(6) Use appropriate language in online communication. Avoid excessive use of emoticons.
(7) Refrain from using local dialects or slang that may lead to misunderstanding.
(8) Do not mock someone's reading or writing abilities when sharing tips with other students.
(9) Consider others' privacy. Obtain permission before sharing classmates' email addresses or other information.
(10) Do not post inappropriate messages; refrain from forwarding virus warnings, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or teachers.
III. Student Responsibilities

Before the start of each semester, confirm and update personal basic information, including phone numbers and mailing addresses, in the MyFCU personal data form for effective communication with instructors, teaching assistants, or department staff.
(1) Ensure that your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID are active, as o365 serves as a common tool for teaching and learning communication between students and faculty.
(2) Clearly communicate information and maintain politeness when exchanging emails, bulletin board posts, etc.
(3) Sign your emails, as teachers will not reply to "anonymous" messages.
Read and understand the course syllabus requirements, promptly update with the latest information, and manage your study time effectively.
Regularly check your Feng Chia University email and log in to iLearn to stay informed about course announcements.
Provide feedback on the course by completing mid-term and end-of-term teaching evaluations based on the teacher's content and teaching methods. Your participation and feedback will help improve teaching skills, course content, and learning activity arrangements. Complete the formative teaching assessment in weeks 4-8, mid-term student opinion survey, and end-of-term course goal achievement assessment in the last month of the semester.
